{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overestimation bias.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% for periods with recent downward price momentum (last 3-5 days trending lower).",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent high prices (last 3-5 days) when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00) to capture momentum.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast is > 1.5σ above recent 30-day mean, reduce by 10-20%.",
    "Cap upward forecasts at 1.2x the 30-day moving average to prevent overshoot after sharp spikes.",
    "Delay forecast adjustment by 1-2 days if sentiment is positive and price is rising — avoid premature overreaction.",
    "If true outcome is > 10% above forecast, reduce next period’s forecast by 5-10% to avoid overcorrection.",
    "For sentiment = 0.25, apply a 3-5% downward bias to model’s peak predictions to account for volatility."
  ]
}
